sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "invoice_lines"."invoice_id" AS e, "customers"."country" AS g, SUM("invoice_lines"."unit_price") AS m1 FROM "invoice_lines" JOIN "invoices" ON "invoices"."id" = "invoice_lines"."invoice_id" JOIN "customers" ON "customers"."id" = "invoices"."customer_id" GROUP BY "invoice_lines"."invoice_id", "customers"."country"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."g" AS g, AVG("s3"."m2") AS v FROM "s3" GROUP BY "s3"."g"), "s5" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, ("s3"."m2" - "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s3"."g" = "s4"."g" WHERE "s3"."m2" > "s4"."v"), "s6" AS (SELECT "s5"."g" AS g, AVG("s5"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s5"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s5"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s5" GROUP BY "s5"."g") SELECT AVG("s6"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s6"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s6"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s6"
